mission: D9 F1 approval runbook (owner ask 2026-10-18 23:11Z, step 2): add the ops-write runbook approve-f1-batch, which approves current exact Yuyu-Tei proposals made by the F1 listing-kind rule in batches of about 500 through the admin page's approve_exact_proposal. Each run waits for the owner in staging-ops; the dry run lists every proposal, a 20-row seeded random sample and storage room; an apply needs the dry run's approved-list SHA-256. Staging only; PSA10 not read; no resolver, alias, collector, setting, price, Market Value/Index, secret or Railway change; no runbook run in this PR (batch 1 only after merge, owner-approved).

impacts.reason: New write runbook approve-f1-batch registered in RUNBOOKS as (write, collector-affecting). Selection is read-only (default_transaction_read_only session); an apply runs only in ops-write after the owner's staging-ops approval, refuses unless the rebuilt list hashes to the dry run's SHA-256, and calls approve_exact_proposal (every admin guard: exact, pending, current, same digest and resolver version, sole recommended print, candidate state, no rejected or conflicting mapping, print verified and not already monitored) once per proposal per transaction. Exact proposals only; ambiguous ones are never approved. run.py --count now defaults per runbook (enqueue-remaining-50 keeps 50).

Adds approve-f1-batch to the runbook choice, makes count optional (empty uses the runbook default) and raises the runbook job timeout to 180 minutes (one fresh resolver run per approval). The owner-approval job, environments, permissions, secrets and triggers are unchanged.
Offline tests for the list pin, seeded sample, count and apply guards, quiet windows and stop-at-first-refusal; runbook documentation.

resources.name: GitHub Actions: ops-write approve-f1-batch (owner-approved runs only)

dependencies: ops-write from PR #150; D9 F1 rule from PR #171 and its rollout PR #173 (unchanged); approve_exact_proposal (unchanged)
impact.deployment_impact: Runbook code and its workflow choice only. collector_services is empty and no raw_dependency_migration: 0 collector rollouts, no DDL. No path under services/, packages/ or apps/ changes; snkrdunk and yuyutei collectors untouched. Merging writes nothing; each later batch is a separate owner-approved run.

recovery.procedure: Native revert of this PR removes the runbook and its workflow choice. No data, schema, provider or service configuration to undo. An approved batch is undone by the admin mapping endpoints (per mapping), not by this revert.
recovery.trigger: A dry run that fails, selects a proposal that is not an exact pending F1 proposal, or a sample row the owner judges wrong.
recovery.backup: Not applicable for this PR: no schema or row change. Railway Postgres daily backups continue.

verification.observation_window: After merge: one ops-readonly db-diagnostic run per new file, dispatched one at a time, completes with status ok, and its ops-summary carries rows or names them in rows_omitted.
